---
title: "About the 3 Bees"
---

The **3 Bees — Basic Biostatistics & Bioinformatics** is a series of short
lectures and hands-on tutorials introducing topics and methods that help with
research projects, especially (but not only) bioinformatics ones. It launched in
**November 2023** and runs roughly **every other Monday at 09:45**, online and on campus at SLU.

It is a collaboration between:

- **[SLUBI](https://www.slubi.se)** — SLU's bioinformatics infrastructure
- **SLU's Center for Statistics**

## How it works

Every session is beginner-friendly. You are welcome to simply come and listen,
or bring a laptop and code along. Slides, tutorials, scripts, and notebooks for
each session are collected here and linked from every workshop's page.

## Suggest a topic

The schedule is shaped by what people want to learn. If there is a topic you'd
like us to cover, [fill out our short questionnaire](https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSfojHf02MqnsVTgKK_tE403ogGI1Pfi9vLg1A407w4SrQbIIw/viewform)
to influence the next round of workshops.
